Gradually, a full-fledged defense system is built around the village, with improved fighters, buffs, and constant territorial expansion. Some upgrades speed up resource acquisition, others help more effectively fend off waves of slimes, or strengthen mercenaries for future battles. Even after a long time, new upgrades and challenges are added, so the settlement continues to grow almost without stopping.

Features of the game

Village development through the idle progress system. Construction of buildings and strengthening of the base. Hiring heroes and protecting the settlement. Endless growth and new improvements.

Installation:
1. Unpack the archive (make sure the folder path has Latin characters only).
2. Run the game.
